scope: Curated global discovery directory, not an exhaustive census. Organizations and operating businesses are listed; they are not asserted independent issuers or additive revenue pools.
financial_coverage_note: Six companies have historical financial datasets: NVIDIA, TSMC, ASML, Micron, Texas Instruments and Amkor. Discovery listings do not imply financial coverage. Inspect native currency, annual periods and company-specific definitions.
